Job description:


Admin Assistant:


About the Role:


TIMBERTEK is a Dubai-based wood flooring company specializing in solid wood flooring installation, restoration, maintenance, sanding, and polishing for premium residential and hospitality projects.


We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Admin assistant to support our day-to-day operations, coordinate projects, and ensure smooth communication between clients, suppliers, and the internal team.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Oversee daily administrative tasks, including documentation, filing, and record management.
  • Coordinate schedules between the sales team, site team, and clients for installations, maintenance, and restoration projects.
  • Prepare quotations, invoices, and maintain payment records.
  • Maintain project documentation, service records, and job files.
  • Monitor inventory of flooring materials, finishing products, and tools, and coordinate replenishment with suppliers.
  • Assist the site team with scheduling, site access arrangements, and client follow-ups.
  • Respond to client enquiries via phone, email, and WhatsApp, and arrange site visits and quotation requests.
  • Maintain supplier and client databases, contracts, and related documentation.
  • Support general office administration, including attendance records and procurement of office and site supplies.
  • Prepare basic reports on project progress, service requests, and ongoing jobs.




Requirements:


  • Prior experience in the renovation or maintenance industry is essential.
  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in administration or office coordination, preferably within fit-out, interiors, flooring, maintenance, construction, or contracting.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and coordinate with clients, suppliers, and site teams.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and comfortable learning CRM, scheduling software, and AI tools to improve workflow.
  • Process-oriented with strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong written English and communication skills.




Salary: AED 3000 per month


Work Arrangement:


This role is currently work-from-home. Depending on business requirements and performance, it may transition to a remote, hybrid, or onsite position in the future.


Why Join Us?


Join a collaborative and fast-paced team where your attention to detail, organizational skills, and ideas for improving processes will be valued and encouraged.


Job Type: Full-time


Work Location: Remote
